mistakeTags.name: Polynomial Subtraction Sign Slip

mistakeTags.label: Omitted or miscalculated outer/inner cross terms in FOIL binomial multiplication
mistakeTags.name: FOIL Cross-Term Error

mistakeTags.label: Squared binomial as (ax - b)^2 = a^2 x^2 + b^2, omitting -2abx cross term
mistakeTags.name: Freshman's Dream Binomial Square Trap

mistakeTags.label: Subtracted inner dimension linearly instead of subtracting inner polynomial area

problems.context: Polynomials: Special Products & Invariant Area Synthesis
problems.prompt: An outer rectangular solar panel has length $(5x + 4)$ and width $(5x - 4)$. An inner cutout has length $(5x + 6)$ and width $(5x - 6)$. Find the constant difference $(\text{Area}_{\text{outer}} - \text{Area}_{\text{inner}})$, which is independent of $x$.
problems.checkpointHint: Expand each product using the difference of squares or square of a binomial identity, then cancel opposing terms.

steps.explain: Expand the outer product using the difference of squares.
Expand the inner product using the difference of squares.
Subtract the two polynomials so the quadratic terms cancel.

problems.context: Polynomials: Special Products & Invariant Area Synthesis
problems.prompt: Simplify the polynomial identity $(3x + 4)^2 - (3x - 4)^2$ and evaluate the resulting expression at $x = 8$.
problems.checkpointHint: Expand each product using the difference of squares or square of a binomial identity, then cancel opposing terms.

steps.explain: Expand both binomial squares.
Subtracting cancels the squared terms and doubles the middle term to $4abx$.
Evaluate at $x = 8$.
